text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: "Last time was truly an offense to the ears... No, calling it a performance is giving it too much credit."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Not only to you, but to the other musicistas as well...
I've done you all a terrible disservice.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
However, I'm fine today.
I'm in great shape—cantabile!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I promise you,
I won't let any sorrowful melodies echo forth.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"For the sake of the spettatori
who are eagerly awaiting my performance..."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Let us play...
the supreme musica! Suoniamo!"
